title: 1970 Topps #32 Jerry Rush Detroit Lions Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1970 Topps sports trading card features Jerry Rush, a rookie player from the Detroit Lions team in the National Football League (NFL). The card number is 32 and it belongs to the base set. It is a great addition for collectors, especially those who are fans of football and the NFL. The card has not been autographed and is in its original state.

The manufacturer of the card is Topps and it was produced in 1970. It is a must-have for any serious collector of sports trading cards. The card is categorized under Trading Card Singles and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this piece of sports history to your collection.
